At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

  • Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

  • Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI’s Future Products

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.

Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

Future Platforms will operate as a startup within a startup, run like a Seed or Series A company but with the capital, resources, and market access of a well-funded Series E, deep C-suite involvement (CEO, CRO, CSO, CTO) and founder-level ownership from day one.

About The Role

As an Engagement Lead on the Future Platforms team, you’ll help found and scale a critical new function at EliseAI: taking our future platform products from early customer promise to live, adopted, business-impacting deployments. This is a cross-functional, high-autonomy role that sits at the intersection of product, strategy, and execution.

You’ll act as the primary driver of engagement success: building alignment across complex customer stakeholder groups, guiding high-stakes implementation and workflow decisions, and coordinating tightly with Product and Engineering to translate real-world needs into clear requirements and shipped improvements. Because this platform is early-stage and scaling quickly, you won’t just run engagements—you’ll systematize how we do them, building repeatable playbooks, processes, and systems that let us scale rapidly without losing quality.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to operate like a founder: comfortable with ambiguity, strong in stakeholder management and execution, energized by building internal systems that scale, and willing to do whatever it takes to drive customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own engagement success end-to-end: Serve as the primary driver of customer deployments from late-stage sales handoff through launch and post-launch stabilization; ensure outcomes, timelines, and stakeholder alignment

  • Support sales and expansion: Participate in later-stage sales and pre-sales discovery to set up successful engagements; help scope realistic engagements and identify follow-on opportunities

  • Lead discovery, scoping, and decisioning: Translate fuzzy goals into crisp requirements, workflows, success metrics, and rollout plans; guide customers through tradeoffs, product constraints, and adoption choices

  • Run the execution motion: Maintain multi-threaded project plans under ambiguity; coordinate across internal teams and external stakeholders; create clear operating cadences, risk tracking, and launch readiness

  • Configuration and launch: Collaborate with product operations, engineering, and training teams to drive product configuration, data migration, launch, and successful adoption

  • Inform and support product development: Partner with Product/Engineering to define net-new product workflows and requirements and help shape the product roadmap—based on scoping learnings, customer input, and real-world usage

  • Build the scalable playbook: Turn lessons from engagements into repeatable processes, templates, and systems—improving speed and quality as we scale

  • Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

We’re looking for intensely driven, founder-minded leaders who want to test themselves and build something transformational. You likely have:

  • 5–8 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, product management, and/or founder/operator roles at high-growth startups

  • Strong technical intuition, demonstrated by STEM degree or equivalent technical background

  • Proven ability to take ownership and operate autonomously with strong judgement in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

  • Proven ability to independently manage complex projects end-to-end in a client facing setting

  • Excellent communication and ability to naturally build strong relationships and influence across internal and external stakeholders

  • Ability to operate creatively and flexibly while maintaining sharp attention to detail

  • Willingness to travel ~1x per month for ~3 days

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $190,000 - $250,000 USD/CAD. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with EliseAI is on an “at-will” basis, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We will also consider qualified applicants in accordance with the Austin Fair Chance Hiring Ordinance.

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at interview.accommodations@meetelise.com.

  • Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

 

The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI’s Future Products

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.

 

Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

 

Future Platforms will operate as a startup within a startup, run like a Seed or Series A company but with the capital, resources, and market access of a well-funded Series E, deep C-suite involvement (CEO, CRO, CSO, CTO) and founder-level ownership from day one.

 

About The Role

As a Deployment Strategist on the Future Platforms team, you'll help found and scale a critical new function at EliseAI: taking our future platform products from early customer promise to live, adopted, business-impacting deployments. This is a cross-functional, high-autonomy role that centers on strategic execution, with real influence over the product and the motion around it.

 

You'll act as the primary driver of engagement success: building alignment across complex customer stakeholder groups, guiding high-stakes implementation and workflow decisions, and coordinating tightly with Product and Engineering to translate real-world needs into clear requirements and shipped improvements. Because this platform is early-stage and scaling quickly, you'll run engagements and help systematize how we do them, building repeatable playbooks, processes, and systems that let us scale rapidly without losing quality.

 

This role is ideal for someone who wants to own complex deployment outcomes end-to-end: comfortable with ambiguity, strong in stakeholder management and execution, energized by building internal systems that scale, and willing to do whatever it takes to drive customer outcomes.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Own engagement success end-to-end: Serve as the primary driver of customer deployments from late-stage sales handoff through launch and post-launch stabilization; ensure outcomes, timelines, and stakeholder alignment

  • Lead discovery, scoping, and decisioning: Translate fuzzy goals into crisp requirements, workflows, success metrics, and rollout plans; guide customers through tradeoffs, product constraints, and adoption choices

  • Run the execution motion: Hold a full book of concurrent deployments at different stages; coordinate internal teams and client stakeholders; keep cadence, risk tracking, and launch readiness current on every one without dropping threads

  • Run the execution motion: Maintain multi-threaded project plans under ambiguity; coordinate across internal teams and external stakeholders; create clear operating cadences, risk tracking, and launch readiness

  • Configuration and launch: Collaborate with product operations, engineering, and training teams to drive product configuration, data migration, launch, and successful adoption

  • Support change management: Partner with client leadership on communicating the change through their organization, and identify where workflows or incentives need to shift for adoption to stick

  • Inform product development: Bring net-new workflow and product requirements to Product/Engineering, grounded in scoping learnings, customer input, and real-world usage

  • Contribute to the playbook: Feed lessons from engagements into the processes and templates that improve speed and quality as we scale

  • Support sales and expansion: Participate in later-stage sales and pre-sales discovery to set up successful engagements; help scope realistic engagements and identify follow-on opportunities

  • Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

 

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

 

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

 

Requirements

We’re looking for founder-minded leaders who take pride in getting complex enterprise deployments live and keeping them healthy. You likely have:

  • 3–5 years running enterprise software implementations, platform migrations, or technology transformation programs, for example implementation and delivery roles at enterprise SaaS companies, technology consulting, or systems integration

  • Demonstrated track record of taking enterprise deployments live: you can speak to specific implementations you’ve owned, the obstacles you hit, and how you got to launch

  • Strong technical intuition, demonstrated by STEM degree or equivalent technical background

  • Proven ability to take ownership and operate autonomously with strong judgement in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

  • Proven ability to independently manage complex projects end-to-end in a client facing setting

  • Excellent communication and ability to naturally build strong relationships and influence across internal and external stakeholders

  • Ability to operate creatively and flexibly while maintaining sharp attention to detail

  • Willingness to travel ~2x per month for ~2-3 days

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

 

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

 

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

 

EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with EliseAI is on an “at-will” basis, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We will also consider qualified applicants in accordance with the Austin Fair Chance Hiring Ordinance.

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at interview.accommodations@meetelise.com.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

  • Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

  • Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI’s Future Products

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.

Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

Future Platforms will operate as a startup within a startup, run like a Seed or Series A company but with the capital, resources, and market access of a well-funded Series E, deep C-suite involvement (CEO, CRO, CSO, CTO) and founder-level ownership from day one.

About The Role

As an Engagement Manager on the Future Platforms team, you'll help found and scale a critical new function at EliseAI: taking our future platform products from early customer promise to live, adopted, business-impacting deployments. This is a cross-functional, high-autonomy role that centers on strategic execution, with real influence over the product and the motion around it.

You'll act as the primary driver of engagement success: building alignment across complex customer stakeholder groups, guiding high-stakes implementation and workflow decisions, and coordinating tightly with Product and Engineering to translate real-world needs into clear requirements and shipped improvements. Because this platform is early-stage and scaling quickly, you'll run engagements and help systematize how we do them, building repeatable playbooks, processes, and systems that let us scale rapidly without losing quality.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to own complex deployment outcomes end-to-end: comfortable with ambiguity, strong in stakeholder management and execution, energized by building internal systems that scale, and willing to do whatever it takes to drive customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own engagement success end-to-end: Serve as the primary driver of customer deployments from late-stage sales handoff through launch and post-launch stabilization; ensure outcomes, timelines, and stakeholder alignment

  • Lead discovery, scoping, and decisioning: Translate fuzzy goals into crisp requirements, workflows, success metrics, and rollout plans; guide customers through tradeoffs, product constraints, and adoption choices

  • Run the execution motion: Hold a full book of concurrent deployments at different stages; coordinate internal teams and client stakeholders; keep cadence, risk tracking, and launch readiness current on every one without dropping threads

  • Run the execution motion: Maintain multi-threaded project plans under ambiguity; coordinate across internal teams and external stakeholders; create clear operating cadences, risk tracking, and launch readiness

  • Configuration and launch: Collaborate with product operations, engineering, and training teams to drive product configuration, data migration, launch, and successful adoption

  • Support change management: Partner with client leadership on communicating the change through their organization, and identify where workflows or incentives need to shift for adoption to stick

  • Inform product development: Bring net-new workflow and product requirements to Product/Engineering, grounded in scoping learnings, customer input, and real-world usage

  • Contribute to the playbook: Feed lessons from engagements into the processes and templates that improve speed and quality as we scale

  • Support sales and expansion: Participate in later-stage sales and pre-sales discovery to set up successful engagements; help scope realistic engagements and identify follow-on opportunities

  • Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff. We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

We’re looking for founder-minded leaders who take pride in getting complex enterprise deployments live and keeping them healthy. You likely have:

  • 3–5 years running enterprise software implementations, platform migrations, or technology transformation programs, for example implementation and delivery roles at enterprise SaaS companies, technology consulting, or systems integration

  • Demonstrated track record of taking enterprise deployments live: you can speak to specific implementations you’ve owned, the obstacles you hit, and how you got to launch

  • Strong technical intuition, demonstrated by STEM degree or equivalent technical background

  • Proven ability to take ownership and operate autonomously with strong judgement in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

  • Proven ability to independently manage complex projects end-to-end in a client facing setting

  • Excellent communication and ability to naturally build strong relationships and influence across internal and external stakeholders

  • Ability to operate creatively and flexibly while maintaining sharp attention to detail

  • Willingness to travel ~2x per month for ~2-3 days

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with EliseAI is on an “at-will” basis, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We will also consider qualified applicants in accordance with the Austin Fair Chance Hiring Ordinance.

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at interview.accommodations@meetelise.com.

EliseAI is looking for a Customer Training Specialist to ensure a seamless onboarding process and transition for our clients as they adopt our products. You will work closely with the Director of Customer Success and other teams to develop and execute comprehensive onboarding strategies. This role requires a blend of customer-facing interactions, content creation, technical expertise, and a proactive approach to gathering and incorporating client feedback.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct thorough onboarding sessions with new and existing customers, ensuring they have a deep understanding of our products and how to leverage them effectively

  • Develop and deliver engaging training sessions, both in-person and remotely, tailored to the specific needs and preferences of each client

  • Proactively seek feedback from customers throughout the onboarding process, identifying areas for improvement and implementing strategies to address any gaps or challenges

  • Act as a liaison between customers and internal teams, advocating for client needs and contributing to product enhancements based on user feedback

  • Stay informed about industry trends and best practices in customer training and onboarding, continuously seeking opportunities to enhance our approach and deliver exceptional experiences

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, preferably in customer success, training, teaching, facilitation, or a related field

  • Willingness to travel as needed to conduct in-person training sessions with clients

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information in a clear and understandable manner

  • Technical proficiency, with the ability to quickly learn and demonstrate expertise in our products or services

  • Experience creating educational content, including videos, tutorials, and documentation preferred

  • Proven ability to build rapport with customers and establish trusted advisor relationships

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively

  • Willing to work in person with your team 4-5 days per week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded startup that’s scaling. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range:

The salary range for this role is $90,000 - $130,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

About The Role

We're looking for a Solutions Engineer to join our pre-sales and implementation team: someone who thrives at the intersection of technical depth, strategic thinking, and customer obsession.

This is not a support role. You'll be embedded in our most complex, high-value enterprise engagements, partnering alongside Engagement Managers and Customer Success Managers to architect, configure, and activate EliseAI's platform for our most strategic customers. You'll own the technical work stream from pre-sales through go-live, ensuring every customer is set up for long-term success from day one.

The ideal candidate has worn multiple hats (Implementation Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Product Generalist) and brings a rare combination of hands-on technical ability, cross-vertical curiosity, and a genuine passion for making customers successful. You're equally comfortable in a configuration console and a boardroom, and you know how to build a compelling case for best practices without losing the human side of the conversation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own technical implementation end-to-end across enterprise accounts, from presales discovery through configuration, testing, and go-live

  • Partner closely with Engagement Managers and Customer Success Managers to deliver a seamless, coordinated experience for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise customers

  • Drive technical discovery during pre-sales by mapping customer workflows, identifying configuration requirements, and translating them into actionable implementation plans

  • Configure and activate EliseAI's platform to match the unique operational needs of each customer, applying deep product knowledge across housing verticals

  • Build and present best practice recommendations tailored to each customer's operational model, advocating for configurations that drive adoption and outcomes

  • Develop and maintain expertise across multiple verticals, becoming a trusted advisor who understands the nuances of different customer segments and use cases

  • Serve as the internal voice of the customer, synthesizing implementation learnings into actionable feedback for Product and Engineering

  • Contribute to scalable internal assets including playbooks, configuration templates, and onboarding frameworks that raise the bar for the broader team

  • Proactively identify risks in customer deployments and take initiative to resolve them before they escalate

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff. We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in solutions engineering, implementation engineering, technical account management, or a closely related presales/post-sales technical role

  • Proven track record of owning technical implementation for enterprise-grade customers, ideally in a SaaS or AI/ML-driven product environment

  • Strong technical foundation: comfortable with APIs, system integrations, data flows, and configuration-heavy platforms; SQL proficiency and familiarity with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau) a plus

  • Excellent communicator and relationship builder: able to translate technical complexity into clear, confident language for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Strategically minded with strong customer instincts: you don't just implement; you advise, consult, and advocate for what will actually work

  • Highly cross-functional: experienced working across Sales, CS, Product, and Engineering with a collaborative, no-ego approach

  • Vertically curious: eager to develop deep expertise across multiple customer segments and become a go-to resource for product knowledge

  • Organized and accountable: capable of managing multiple high-stakes implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball

  • Customer-first mentality: you measure your success by your customers' outcomes

  • Willingness to work on-site at our office 4–5 days per week

Why Join

This is a chance to join a funded unicorn at a pivotal stage of growth, working on problems that genuinely matter in housing and healthcare. You won't be following a playbook; you'll be writing one. Every engagement is an opportunity to learn, build, and make a measurable impact for customers and the business alike.

Benefits

In addition to meaningful work and real growth opportunity, we offer:

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend

  • Fully stocked kitchen with all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • Relocation packages covered

Job Compensation

The salary range for this role is $135,000 – $200,000. In addition to base salary, this role includes a launch-based SPIFF program, providing additional earning opportunities tied directly to successful customer go-lives. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package including base salary, variable compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Exact compensation is determined based on experience, skill level, location, and qualifications assessed during the interview process.


EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with EliseAI is on an “at-will” basis, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We will also consider qualified applicants in accordance with the Austin Fair Chance Hiring Ordinance.

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at interview.accommodations@meetelise.com.

jobs.title: Strategy and Operations, Future Platforms Associate/Sr Associate | Housing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

  • Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

  • Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI’s Future Products

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.

Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

Future Platforms will operate as a startup within a startup, run like a Seed or Series A company but with the capital, resources, and market access of a well-funded Series E, deep C-suite involvement (CEO, CRO, CSO, CTO) and founder-level ownership from day one.

About The Role

As a Strategy and Operations, Future Platforms Associate/Sr Associate on the Future Platforms team, you’ll help found and scale a critical new function at EliseAI: taking our future platform products from early customer promise to live, adopted, business-impacting deployments. This is a strategy role sitting inside a deployment function. You'll own how our deployment motion works and scales with our platform.

You'll take ownership of a core piece of that motion and go deep: diagnosing where it breaks today, designing how it should work, and driving the change across Product, Engineering, Partnerships, and Delivery until it holds at scale. You'll also carry one or two engagements yourself, so you experience the problems you are trying to fix.

You'll partner closely with senior leadership, but you'll own outcomes. This role is ideal for someone who wants to operate like a founder: comfortable with ambiguity, energized by turning a messy, undocumented process into a system that scales, and willing to do whatever it takes to make it real.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own core pieces of the deployment motion: Take a defined slice, such as scoping methodology, migration readiness, or the product requirements pipeline, and take it to the next level: sharpen the standards, close the gaps that surface at volume, and put real measurement behind it

  • Diagnose where the motion breaks: Use engagement data, retrospectives, and direct observation to find what actually drives deployment timeline, cost, and quality, and prioritize accordingly

  • Plan for the next order of magnitude: Model what the function needs at several times today's volume, identify the constraints that break first, and make the case for building ahead of them

  • Design and drive execution: Define priorities, timelines, and success metrics, then push changes through Product and delivery teams until they stick

  • Carry one or two engagements: Stay close enough to the customer-facing reality to pressure-test what you're building, and to keep your recommendations credible with the people running deployments full time

  • Shape the product roadmap: Turn patterns across engagements into prioritized requirements with Product and Engineering, grounded in what deployments actually surface

  • Build the team: Help hire, onboard, and ramp the people running engagements, and codify what good looks like

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

We’re looking for intensely driven, founder-minded leaders who want to test themselves and build something transformational. You likely have:

  • 2 - 4 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, product management, and/or founder/operator roles at high-growth startups

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions

  • A track record of designing and standing up processes or systems that kept working after you moved on

  • Strong technical intuition, demonstrated by STEM degree or equivalent technical background

  • Proven ability to take ownership and operate autonomously with strong judgement in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

  • Proven ability to independently manage complex projects end-to-end in a client facing setting

  • Excellent communication and ability to naturally build strong relationships and influence across internal and external stakeholders

  • Willingness to travel ~1x per month for ~3 days

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for the Associate role is $110,000 - $130,000, and for Senior Associate is $120,000 - $170,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with EliseAI is on an “at-will” basis, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We will also consider qualified applicants in accordance with the Austin Fair Chance Hiring Ordinance.

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at interview.accommodations@meetelise.com.

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be. 

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.



 - Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

 - Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.
   
   

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million https://eliseai.com/blog/intelligence-is-getting-cheaper-life-should-too funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.



About The Role

We’re looking for a Lead Economist to build EliseAI’s economics research and market insights function. You’ll transform our proprietary data into benchmarks and compelling narratives that establish EliseAI as the leading authority on housing. You’ll own the full pipeline from raw data to market-shaping insight and serve as EliseAI’s voice on what the numbers mean.



Key Responsibilities

 - Establish EliseAI as the leading authority on rental housing through original research and market insights using our proprietary data.

 - Define and amplify EliseAI’s voice on housing economics across media, industry events, research, and customer channels.

 - Partner with marketing to create high-impact content that strengthens the brand and engages customers.

 - Partner with product and data teams to understand product data, build reliable data pipelines, and create scalable reporting.

 - Expand the reach of EliseAI’s research through partnerships with publications and academic institutions.

 - Use research and thought leadership to strengthen EliseAI’s employer brand, helping attract exceptional talent across the entire company.



Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff. We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.



Requirements

 - 3+ years of experience in insights, data journalism, analytics, economic research, or strategy & operations with a track record of shipping quantitative work for external audiences

 - Exceptional data storytelling: you can turn complex findings into sharp narratives

 - Comfortable presenting findings live to executives, clients, or media

 - Strong technical skills across the modern data stack (SQL, Python, Hex, etc.)

 - A genuine curiosity about housing and the data that explains the industry

 - A quantitative degree or equivalent practical experience

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment.

 - Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week



Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn https://www.eliseai.com/blog/eliseai-raises-250m-series-e!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.



Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

 - Equity in the company

 - Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

 - Fully paid parental leave

 - Commuter benefits

 - 401k benefits

 - Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

 - A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

 - Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

 - We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!



Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $150,000 - $250,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.



EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with EliseAI is on an “at-will” basis, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive, Future Platforms | Housing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

  • Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

  • Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI’s Future Products

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.

Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

Future Platforms will operate as a startup within a startup, run like a Seed or Series A company but with the capital, resources, and market access of a well-funded Series E, deep C-suite involvement (CEO, CRO, CSO, CTO) and founder-level ownership from day one.

About The Role

As a Mid-Market Account Executive on the Future Platforms team, you’ll help build the commercial foundation for EliseAI’s next generation of products and business lines. You’ll own the full sales cycle—from identifying early customers and shaping the value proposition to navigating complex evaluations, closing high-value deals, and identifying expansion opportunities.

This is not a traditional sales role with a fully established playbook. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Strategy, and post-sales teams to bring evolving products to market, translate customer needs into product direction, and determine how we position, package, and sell them at scale.

You’ll be expected to operate with the urgency, creativity, and ownership of an early-stage founder while benefiting from EliseAI’s existing customer relationships, market access, capital, and proven distribution. The opportunity is to help turn a new, core part of the business into its next major growth engine.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle for our Future Platforms: from prospecting and early discovery through product demonstrations, negotiations, closing, and expansion

  • Build relationships with C-suite, VP, and Director-level stakeholders and develop the business case for adopting new, transformational products

  • Identify and engage early customers who can become strategic design partners, reference accounts, and long-term platform customers

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes involving business leaders, operators, technical teams, procurement, and legal

  • Shape the commercial strategy by helping refine positioning, pricing, packaging, target customer profiles, and go-to-market motions

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Strategy, and Deployment teams to translate customer feedback into product requirements and roadmap decisions

  • Develop creative, scrappy approaches to opening new opportunities and building momentum before a mature playbook exists

  • Turn early wins and lessons into repeatable sales processes, messaging, materials, and playbooks that can support rapid scale

  • Attend industry conferences and customer meetings to build market presence and deepen industry relationships

  • Identify expansion opportunities as customers adopt additional products and workflows across the platform

  • Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

Why Top Sales Talent Joins EliseAI

  • Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, pioneering agentic AI to transform how property management operates.

  • $200M+ ARR with 100% year-over-year growth.

  • 5M units and 1 in 6 apartments in the U.S powered by EliseAI.

  • Proven product-market fit and rapid industry adoption.

  • High-ACV, fast-moving deals and consistently strong team attainment.

    • Top three AEs on pace to book $65M+ in ARR this year

  • Ranked among the top sales organizations on RepVue.

Reporting to the Financial Controller, the Junior Billing & Accounts Receivable Specialist will support collection activities, track slow-paying customers, and escalate unresolved accounts to the appropriate teams. Additionally, they will assist with billing tasks. EliseAI is growing its in-house Accounting department to create a top-tier team that drives the company’s growth by supporting other business functions and providing insights into business performance. This role is crucial for resolving overdue invoices and enhancing the company’s cash flow. The position is based at our New York City headquarters.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor outstanding balances, proactively follow up on overdue accounts, and collaborate with customers to address payment concerns. This includes sending account statements, partnering with Customer Success Managers to resolve issues, and keeping detailed, up-to-date records of collections activities and documentation

  • Ability to handle large volumes of AR and tailor collection methods based on customer responses or lack thereof

  • Support the team by preparing and distributing complex accounts receivable invoices for customers using billing platforms like Subscript, NetSuite, and other relevant tools

  • Create customized customer invoices for submission through third-party billing portals

  • Assist in maintaining up-to-date customer information in Salesforce, NetSuite, and other billing solutions

  • Assist with billing portal registrations and compliance efforts by coordinating with customers and, when necessary, collaborating with the legal team, customer success team, and insurance broker

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; major in accounting, finance, economics, mathematics, or a related field preferred

  • Minimum 2+ years of relevant experience in billing and accounts receivable; high-growth enterprise, SaaS experience preferred

  • Experience with accounting ERP systems in previous role(s) (NetSuite and Salesforce experience preferred)

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Suite applications, with advanced skills in Excel

  • Direct and clear communicator, both written and verbal. Not afraid to speak up

  • Strong problem-solving skills and an interest in continuous process improvement

  • Comfortable handling and analyzing large datasets, including 100,000+ transactions

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Monthly fitness stipend

  • Our brand new Midtown south office with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and company paid lunch

  • Fun company social events through our Elise and the City program

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages from outside of the Greater NYC metro area - we'll make the move exciting, not painful.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

About The Role

We are looking for an Affordable Housing Compliance Expert to ensure the accuracy of resident files across the affordable housing programs our platform supports. You will provide in-house authority on affordable housing compliance and policy — reviewing real tenant files, pressure-testing our automated compliance outputs, and surfacing the complex, real-world cases that should inform how our product evolves.

This is a hands-on review and auditing role. Your focus will be the judgment required for complex compliance cases, and you will be hands-on in the files themselves. You will work closely with our customers and our internal product and engineering teams, collecting findings and sharing them back internally so we can continuously improve how the system handles affordable housing compliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review files for accuracy — Audit resident files across LIHTC (Section 42), HUD Section 8 (HCV, PBV, and PBRA), USDA Rural Development, and related programs for compliance with program rules

  • Own the hard cases — Apply expert judgment to the most complex and ambiguous files — income and asset calculations, imputed income from assets, deductions, and non-standard scenarios

  • Pressure-test the system — Validate automated compliance outputs against program requirements, confirming that calculations, determinations, and supporting language hold up to scrutiny

  • Identify and escalate gaps — Spot where the system does not yet handle a case correctly, document the issue clearly, and escalate the cases that require manual review

  • Feed findings back to product and engineering — Surface patterns and edge cases that should drive automation priorities and product improvements

  • Build reference materials and standards — Distill review patterns and edge cases into clear, durable internal reference guides so compliance knowledge is shared across the team. Key priority: document the compliance decisions made during product development

  • Support testing and validation — Develop representative test cases and support UAT to confirm outputs reconcile to compliance expectations before release

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

We are looking for the following capabilities. If you do not meet all of these qualifications, but are passionate about affordable housing, have a demonstrated interest in the field, and are a quick learner, we still encourage you to apply

  • 3+ years of hands-on affordable housing compliance file review or auditing experience

  • Deep, practical knowledge of affordable housing programs — LIHTC (Section 42), HUD Section 8 (HCV, PBV, PBRA), and ideally USDA Rural Development — including income and asset determinations, certifications and recertifications, and tenant file requirements.

  • Background as a state housing finance agency auditor, an operator-side compliance professional, or a third-party compliance reviewer

  • One or more relevant certifications: COS, SHCM, TCS, BOS, HCCP, NCP, or similar credentials demonstrating real file-review expertise

  • Strong, clear written communication — able to document findings precisely and explain compliance reasoning to non-experts

  • Comfort working through ambiguous, complex cases independently and at high volume

  • Experience in a software / SaaS environment, or comfort translating program rules into software logic

  • Experience with TRACS / MAT submissions, MORs, or state agency monitoring reviews

  • Familiarity with AI and/or automation as they relate to compliance workflows

We are considering remote candidates, but with preference for candidates based in NYC. Candidates located within commuting distance of NYC will work from our office 4-5 days per week.

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $125,000 - $200,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

  • Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI’s Future Products

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.

Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

Future Platforms will operate as a startup within a startup, run like a Seed or Series A company but with the capital, resources, and market access of a well-funded Series E, deep C-suite involvement (CEO, CRO, CSO, CTO) and founder-level ownership from day one.

About The Role

As an Deployment Lead on the Future Platforms team, you will help found and scale a critical function at EliseAI: delivering our accounting platform from initial deployment through full operational adoption.

You will own the accounting layer of complex engagements, serving as the primary driver of successful implementations across multiple clients at once. This means working directly with Controllers, CFOs, and accounting teams to scope workflows, configure systems, drive key decisions, and ensure a clean transition into live operations.

This is a highly cross-functional, execution-heavy role at the intersection of accounting, product, and customer success. Because the platform is early and evolving quickly, you won’t just execute implementations—you’ll help define how they’re done, building scalable systems and playbooks from the ground up.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong accounting intuition with a builder mindset, and wants to operate like a founder in a fast-scaling environment.

Key Responsibilities

Own accounting engagement success end-to-end

  • Drive the accounting portion of multiple concurrent engagements, from late-stage sales handoff through post-launch stabilization

  • Roll off accounts once they are fully live and operating successfully on the platform

  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and operational readiness across all accounting workflows

Lead accounting discovery, scoping, and decisioning

  • Partner with senior accounting stakeholders (Controllers, CFOs, Finance teams) to understand current-state workflows and define future-state processes

  • Drive critical implementation decisions, such as:

    • Bank account onboarding strategy

    • Vendor onboarding and payment workflows

    • Chart of accounts structure and usage

    • Transaction and charge code design

  • Translate ambiguous accounting needs into clear system configurations and requirements

Own configuration and implementation

  • Lead hands-on accounting setup, including:

    • Chart of accounts (COA) configuration

    • Vendor and entity setup

    • Mapping of transactions and workflows

  • Manage detailed back-and-forth with clients to gather, validate, and refine data inputs

  • Ensure integrity and correctness of client-provided materials (e.g., validating GL structures, identifying inconsistencies, resolving gaps)

Drive migration and post-launch success

  • Ensure full readiness for data migration and system cutover

  • Lead post-launch activities, including:

    • Reconciliations and validation of financial data

    • Stabilization of accounting workflows in the new system

    • Kickstarting close processes and operational rhythms

  • Act as the primary owner of a clean, accurate transition into the platform

Enable adoption and training

  • Run trainings, walkthroughs, and tailored demos for accounting teams

  • Ensure end users are confident operating within the new system

  • Identify and resolve adoption blockers early

Build scalable systems and playbooks

  • Turn implementation learnings into repeatable processes, templates, and best practices

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to surface gaps and improve accounting workflows

  • Help define what “great” looks like for accounting implementations at scale

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who blends accounting expertise with strong execution and ownership:

  • 6–8 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, product management, and/or founder/operator roles at high-growth startups

  • Background in accounting or finance (e.g., former Controller, Senior Accountant, accounting consultant, or accounting-focused operator), ideally in a high-growth or tech-enabled environment

  • Experience managing complex, client-facing implementations or projects

  • Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals (GL, reconciliations, close process, workflows)

  • Comfortable getting into the weeds with data, configurations, and systems

  • Excellent communicator who can build trust with senior finance stakeholders

  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple concurrent engagements under tight timelines

  • Autonomous, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in ambiguity

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

  • Willingness to travel ~2x per month for ~2-3 days

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $200,000 - $250,000 USD/CAD. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

  • Support the day-to-day operations of EliseAI's New York headquarters, ensuring the office is organized, welcoming, and operating efficiently

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for Workplace Operations by monitoring Slack, email, office request forms, and other intake channels, ensuring requests are prioritized, communicated, and resolved promptly

  • Coordinate workstation deployments, office moves, workplace technology rollouts, and meeting room readiness in partnership with IT

  • Conduct regular workplace walkthroughs to proactively identify maintenance, safety, and operational issues, ensuring a consistently high standard across the office

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills

  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills

  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through

  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment

  • Able to occasionally lift and move office equipment and supplies

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it.   • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

The hourly rate for this role is $25-35/hour. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package.
