EliseAI is transforming housing and healthcare through best-in-class conversational AI. As we scale, it’s critical that employees, clients, and partners deeply understand how our platform works—and how to use it to drive real outcomes.

As an Instructional Designer at EliseAI, you’ll design high-impact learning experiences that support functional onboarding, product education, and performance enablement. You’ll collaborate closely with subject matter experts across product, engineering, marketing, and client-facing teams to create clear, effective learning content—from in-depth guides and product walkthroughs to internal training modules and scalable enablement assets.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, loves translating complex ideas into intuitive learning experiences, and wants to shape how knowledge is scaled across teams and clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop instructional content that supports onboarding, internal enablement, and product education

  • Partner with subject matter experts and cross-functional teams to gather requirements, validate technical accuracy, and co-create engaging learning experiences

  • Write scripts for training videos, product walkthroughs, demos, and other educational content

  • Translate complex workflows and product features into clear, actionable, and engaging learning experiences

  • Create interactive guides, video explainers, motion graphics, and live training materials to support feature rollouts

  • Leverage Figma to design clean, branded layouts, prototypes, and learning templates

  • Use motion and visual storytelling to make key concepts memorable and easy to grasp

  • Conduct needs assessments, learner research, and usability testing to ensure solutions drive measurable impact

  • Establish and evolve frameworks, templates, and systems to accelerate content creation and improve scalability

  • Regularly audit and iterate content to ensure accessibility, usability, and alignment with business goals

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in instructional design, learning experience design, or enablement in a SaaS or tech environment

  • Strong understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design best practices, and performance-based learning

  • Proficiency in Figma for visual design, prototyping, and collaboration

  • Experience with e-learning and motion design tools (e.g., Articulate 360, Rise, Storyline, Camtasia, After Effects, Premiere Pro)

  • Ability to translate technical and operational concepts into intuitive learning assets

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills across visual, written, and verbal mediums

  • Ability to work autonomously, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment

  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG), SCORM/xAPI, and learner feedback loops

Bonus if you have

  • A degree in Instructional Design, Interaction Design, HCI, or a related visual or digital design field

  • Experience designing education or onboarding experiences for B2B SaaS

  • Background in motion, interaction, or visual storytelling

  • Experience with LMS platforms (e.g., Skilljar, Lessonly, WorkRamp) and performance evaluation frameworks like Kirkpatrick or Bloom’s Taxonomy

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff. We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company in the form of stock options

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Monthly fitness stipend

  • Our brand new Midtown south office with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and company paid lunch

  • Fun company social events through our Elise and the City program

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages from outside of the greater NYC Metro area - we'll make the move exciting, not painful

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $120,000 - $145,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience and skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

  • Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

  • Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI’s Future Products

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.

 

Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

 

Future Platforms will operate as a startup within a startup, run like a Seed or Series A company but with the capital, resources, and market access of a well-funded Series E, deep C-suite involvement (CEO, CRO, CSO, CTO) and founder-level ownership from day one.

About The Role

As a Lead Deployment Strategist on the Future Platforms team, you'll help found and scale a critical new function at EliseAI: taking our future platform products from early customer promise to live, adopted, business-impacting deployments. This is a cross-functional, high-autonomy role that centers on strategic execution, with real influence over the product and the motion around it.

You'll act as the primary driver of engagement success: building alignment across complex customer stakeholder groups, guiding high-stakes implementation and workflow decisions, and coordinating tightly with Product and Engineering to translate real-world needs into clear requirements and shipped improvements. Because this platform is early-stage and scaling quickly, you'll run engagements and help systematize how we do them, building repeatable playbooks, processes, and systems that let us scale rapidly without losing quality.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to own complex deployment outcomes end-to-end: comfortable with ambiguity, strong in stakeholder management and execution, energized by building internal systems that scale, and willing to do whatever it takes to drive customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own engagement success end-to-end: Serve as the primary driver of customer deployments from late-stage sales handoff through launch and post-launch stabilization; ensure outcomes, timelines, and stakeholder alignment

  • Lead discovery, scoping, and decisioning: Translate fuzzy goals into crisp requirements, workflows, success metrics, and rollout plans; guide customers through tradeoffs, product constraints, and adoption choices

  • Run the execution motion: Hold a full book of concurrent deployments at different stages; coordinate internal teams and client stakeholders; keep cadence, risk tracking, and launch readiness current on every one without dropping threads

  • Run the execution motion: Maintain multi-threaded project plans under ambiguity; coordinate across internal teams and external stakeholders; create clear operating cadences, risk tracking, and launch readiness

  • Configuration and launch: Collaborate with product operations, engineering, and training teams to drive product configuration, data migration, launch, and successful adoption

  • Support change management: Partner with client leadership on communicating the change through their organization, and identify where workflows or incentives need to shift for adoption to stick

  • Inform product development: Bring net-new workflow and product requirements to Product/Engineering, grounded in scoping learnings, customer input, and real-world usage

  • Contribute to the playbook: Feed lessons from engagements into the processes and templates that improve speed and quality as we scale

  • Support sales and expansion: Participate in later-stage sales and pre-sales discovery to set up successful engagements; help scope realistic engagements and identify follow-on opportunities

  • Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

 

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

We’re looking for founder-minded leaders who take pride in getting complex enterprise deployments live and keeping them healthy. You likely have:

  • 5–8 years running enterprise software implementations, platform migrations, or technology transformation programs, for example implementation and delivery roles at enterprise SaaS companies, technology consulting, or systems integration

  • Demonstrated track record of taking enterprise deployments live: you can speak to specific implementations you’ve owned, the obstacles you hit, and how you got to launch

  • Strong technical intuition, demonstrated by STEM degree or equivalent technical background

  • Proven ability to take ownership and operate autonomously with strong judgement in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

  • Proven ability to independently manage complex projects end-to-end in a client facing setting

  • Excellent communication and ability to naturally build strong relationships and influence across internal and external stakeholders

  • Ability to operate creatively and flexibly while maintaining sharp attention to detail

  • Willingness to travel ~2x per month for ~2-3 days

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

 

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

 

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $190,000 - $250,000 USD/CAD. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

  • Plan for the next order of magnitude: Model what the function needs at several times today's volume, identify the constraints that break first, and make the case for building ahead of them

  • Design and drive execution: Define priorities, timelines, and success metrics, then push changes through Product and delivery teams until they stick

  • Shape the product roadmap: Turn patterns across engagements into prioritized requirements with Product and Engineering, grounded in what deployments actually surface

  • 3 - 7 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, product management, and/or founder/operator roles at high-growth startups

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions

  • A track record of designing and standing up processes or systems that kept working after you moved on

  • Strong technical intuition, demonstrated by STEM degree or equivalent technical background

  • Proven ability to take ownership and operate autonomously with strong judgement in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

  • Proven ability to independently manage complex projects end-to-end in a client facing setting

  • Excellent communication and ability to naturally build strong relationships and influence across internal and external stakeholders

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

We are looking for an Affordable Housing Compliance Analyst to conduct first-pass reviews of resident files across the affordable housing programs our platform supports. You will apply established program rules and review guidance to check resident files for accuracy, flagging complex or ambiguous cases for escalation to our Tier 2 compliance team.

This is a high-volume, hands-on review role focused on accuracy, consistency, and speed. You will work from documented review guides and reference materials, follow defined escalation criteria, and contribute clear observations that help our Tier 2 team and product organization improve the system over time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review files for accuracy — Conduct first-pass review of resident files across LIHTC (Section 42), HUD Section 8 (HCV, PBV, and PBRA), USDA Rural Development, and related programs for compliance with program rules.

  • Apply standard determinations — Handle routine income and asset calculations, deductions, and certifications using established guidance and reference materials.

  • Flag complex or ambiguous cases — Recognize when a file falls outside standard review criteria and escalate it to Tier 2 with clear, well-documented notes.

  • Verify system outputs on standard cases — Check automated compliance outputs against program requirements for routine files, confirming calculations and determinations are correct.

  • Document findings clearly — Record review notes and observations so patterns and recurring issues can be shared with Tier 2 and product teams.

  • Follow review guides and checklists — Use the reference materials and standards built by Tier 2 to ensure consistent, accurate reviews.

  • Support testing and validation — Help execute test cases and UAT under Tier 2 guidance to confirm outputs reconcile to compliance expectations before release.

  • Meet quality and volume targets — Deliver accurate, timely reviews that meet defined SLAs and quality benchmarks.

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

  • Working knowledge of affordable housing programs — LIHTC (Section 42), HUD Section 8 (HCV, PBV, PBRA), and/or USDA Rural Development — including income and asset determinations, certifications and recertifications, and tenant file requirements.

  • Comfort following established guidelines and escalation criteria — you know when to apply a rule and when to flag something for senior review.

  • Certifications such as COS, SHCM, TCS, BOS, HCCP, or NCP are a plus, but not required.

  • Clear written communication — able to document findings precisely and completely.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to work accurately at high volume.

  • Comfort working in a software / SaaS environment, or willingness to learn how program rules translate into software logic.

  • Familiarity with AI and/or automation as they relate to compliance workflows is a plus.

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $80,000 - $100,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI’s Future Products

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.

 

Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

 

Future Platforms will operate as a startup within a startup, run like a Seed or Series A company but with the capital, resources, and market access of a well-funded Series E, deep C-suite involvement (CEO, CRO, CSO, CTO) and founder-level ownership from day one.

About The Role

As a Solutions Consultant at EliseAI, you will help found and scale a critical function at the intersection of product, growth, and finance.

You will serve as the accounting and finance subject matter expert in the room—partnering directly with our product and GTM team to win enterprise deals, shape product direction, and build credibility with senior finance leaders. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role where you’ll help translate Elise’s platform into the language of CFOs and Controllers while influencing how our accounting product evolves. Additionally, you will help make strategic decisions and weigh in on product direction and scoping, and develop a robust product tool kit.

You’ll operate like a founder: owning ambiguous problems, driving deals forward, and helping define how Elise wins with finance buyers.

Key Responsibilities

Own finance-facing sales support

  • Partner with Sales and Account Executives on enterprise and strategic deals as the accounting/finance expert

  • Lead tailored product demos for CFOs, Controllers, and Finance leaders, translating platform capabilities into clear accounting workflows and outcomes

  • Act as the bridge between technical product capabilities and real-world finance operations

Be the credibility layer for finance buyers

  • Engage directly with prospect CFOs, VPs of Finance, and Controllers to build trust in Elise’s accounting rigor

  • Confidently handle detailed accounting and workflow questions, such as:

    • Intercompany eliminations

    • Bank reconciliation processes

    • Period close workflows

    • Audit readiness and controls

  • Position Elise as a system finance teams can rely on for accuracy, compliance, and scalability

Shape product through customer insight

  • Translate recurring objections, feature gaps, and workflow needs into actionable product feedback

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to refine accounting features and prioritize roadmap investments

  • Help define what “best-in-class” looks like for accounting workflows within Elise

Drive go-to-market strategy for accounting product

  • Support positioning, messaging, and enablement for finance-specific use cases

  • Build demo environments, playbooks, and repeatable narratives for selling into finance teams

  • Enable the broader GTM org to confidently speak to accounting personas

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements:

We’re looking for someone who combines deep accounting expertise with a builder mindset:

  • Background as a Controller, Accounting Manager, or finance related roles (ideally in a high-growth or tech-enabled environment)

  • Experience working at or closely with tech startups (fintech, ERP, accounting software, or adjacent)

  • Strong understanding of core accounting workflows (close, reconciliations, consolidations, controls)

  • Comfortable translating between finance, product, and technical teams

  • Excellent communicator who can build credibility with senior finance stakeholders quickly

  • Highly autonomous, action-oriented, and comfortable operating in ambiguity

  • Excited to help define a new function and influence product direction

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Monthly fitness stipend

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and company-paid lunch

  • Fun company social events through our Elise and the City program

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The OTE range for this role is $200,000 - $275,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

  • Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

  • Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

About The Role

We are seeking a Compliance Officer to help build and operate our AML/BSA, KYC/KYB, fraud detection and loss prevention, and sanctions compliance programs. This role will be instrumental in maintaining regulatory readiness, managing relationships with banking and financial institution partners, and ensuring our policies, processes, and systems support responsible growth.

You will work cross-functionally with Legal, Product, Engineering, Operations, and business stakeholders to operationalize compliance efforts, support audits and examinations, and improve KYC and transaction-monitoring workflows. This is a high-impact role with direct influence on our ability to meet critical compliance timelines, maintain trusted partner relationships, and support the operations of the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and continuously improve the company's fraud monitoring, KYC/KYB, AML/BSA and OFAC/sanctions compliance programs, including policies, procedures, risk assessments, and governance materials

  • Serve as a primary compliance contact for banking, fintech, and other financial institution partners, overseeing recurring meetings, reporting cycles, obligations, open items, and escalations

  • Lead KYC/KYB processes, oversee transaction-monitoring operations, review escalated alerts and investigations, and prepare Unusual Activity Reports (UARs) and other required reports for financial institution partners

  • Work with Legal, Product, and Engineering to translate regulatory requirements into practical workflows, controls, system rules, audit trails, and monitoring capabilities

  • Contribute compliance guidance to new products and market initiatives, identifying risks early and helping teams launch responsibly at speed

  • Coordinate compliance testing, audits, examinations, issue remediation, and responses to partner or regulator requests

  • Track state and federal regulatory developments, translating them into clear, prioritized actions for the business

  • Help build a culture where compliance is practical, embedded in the product, and accountable to real outcomes

  • Own our BSA/AML compliance training program, building content, tracking completion, and reporting to third parties

  • Digitize and organize onsite resident files (income certifications, leases, program forms) so every affordable compliance file is complete, searchable, and audit-ready. This may require occasional travel onsite to visit clients

Requirements

  • 5+ years of AML/BSA compliance experience at a fintech, bank, payment processor, money services business, or comparable regulated financial institution

  • Hands-on experience managing relationships with banking partners, sponsor banks, or other financial institutions

  • Experience building an AML/BSA compliance program from 0 to 1

  • Working knowledge of transaction monitoring, customer identification and due diligence, enhanced due diligence, sanctions screening, investigations, and UAR and SAR processes

  • Strong understanding of FinCEN regulations, the Bank Secrecy Act, and OFAC sanctions requirements

  • Experience with compliance technology and operational tooling; familiarity with platforms such as Sardine or similar systems is a plus

  • Clear written communication, sound judgment, and the ability to translate complex compliance requirements for cross-functional stakeholders

  • Excellent organizational rigor and the ability to manage multiple concurrent deadlines and stakeholders without things slipping

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4–5 days a week

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $190,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at interview.accommodations@meetelise.com.

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.

Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

Future Platforms will operate as a startup within a startup, run like a Seed or Series A company but with the capital, resources, and market access of a well-funded Series E, deep C-suite involvement (CEO, CRO, CSO, CTO) and founder-level ownership from day one.

About The Role

As an Enterprise Account Executive on the Future Platforms team, you’ll help build the commercial foundation for EliseAI’s next generation of products and business lines. You’ll own the full sales cycle—from identifying early customers and shaping the value proposition to navigating complex evaluations, closing high-value deals, and identifying expansion opportunities.

This is not a traditional sales role with a fully established playbook. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Strategy, and post-sales teams to bring evolving products to market, translate customer needs into product direction, and determine how we position, package, and sell them at scale.

You’ll be expected to operate with the urgency, creativity, and ownership of an early-stage founder while benefiting from EliseAI’s existing customer relationships, market access, capital, and proven distribution. The opportunity is to help turn a new, core part of the business into its next major growth engine.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle for our Future Platforms: from prospecting and early discovery through product demonstrations, negotiations, closing, and expansion

  • Build relationships with C-suite, VP, and Director-level stakeholders and develop the business case for adopting new, transformational products

  • Identify and engage early customers who can become strategic design partners, reference accounts, and long-term platform customers

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes involving business leaders, operators, technical teams, procurement, and legal

  • Develop creative, scrappy approaches to opening new opportunities and building momentum before a mature playbook exists

  • Turn early wins and lessons into repeatable sales processes, messaging, materials, and playbooks that can support rapid scale

  • Attend industry conferences and customer meetings to build market presence and deepen industry relationships

  • Identify expansion opportunities as customers adopt additional products and workflows across the platform

  • Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

  • Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, pioneering agentic AI to transform how property management operates.

  • $200M+ ARR with 100% year-over-year growth.

  • 5M units and 1 in 6 apartments in the U.S powered by EliseAI.

  • Proven product-market fit and rapid industry adoption.

  • High-ACV, fast-moving deals and consistently strong team attainment.

    • Top three AEs on pace to book $65M+ in ARR this year

  • Ranked among the top sales organizations on RepVue.

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.
We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.


We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

  • 5+ years quota carrying sales experience

  • Minimum annual quota of $1.2M of SaaS or net revenue in a quota carrying role

  • Demonstrated experience in consistently meeting and exceeding sales quotas

  • Experience in managing complex sales processes (multi-threading, procurement, etc.)

  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to sell products that are early, evolving, or creating a new category

  • Bonus: Experience selling new products, launching new markets, or working at an early-stage or high-growth technology company

  • Comfortable with regular travel for conferences and client visits

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI's Future Products

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.

Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

Future Platforms will operate as a startup within a startup, run like a Seed or Series A company but with the capital, resources, and market access of a well-funded Series E, deep C-suite involvement (CEO, CRO, CSO, CTO) and founder-level ownership from day one.

About The Role

As the Deployment Strategist, you'll help clients make sense of their technology and vendor landscape, and design the future state of each client's ecosystem integrations in order to unlock the most of the EliseAI platform’s automation potential. You will then drive that vision to a live, working implementation. This is a cross-functional, high-autonomy role that centers on strategic execution, with real influence over how we build and scale this motion.

You'll work hand-in-hand with Engagement Managers in the Future Platforms team, who own the overall client relationship, and the Partnerships team, who build relationships with the ecosystem of technology partners you'll draw on. Because this function is early and scaling quickly, you won't just run these engagements - you'll systematize how we do them, building the repeatable playbooks, processes, and vendor knowledge base that let us do this well at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own vendor and technology advisory end-to-end: serve as the primary advisor to clients navigating their technology stack, from initial assessment through implementation and go-live

  • Lead discovery and decisioning: translate a client's existing vendor landscape into clear future state recommendations

  • Drive partner enablement: facilitate client-to-vendor dialogues, coordinate with technology partners and internal stakeholders to scope and drive new integrations, and manage vendor implementations in support of client launches

  • Contribute to the playbook: feed lessons from client engagements into the processes, templates, and automation that improve speed and quality as we scale

 

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

 

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

We're looking for driven, founder-minded professionals who take pride in getting clients set up for long-term success. You likely have:

  • 2-4 years of experience in implementation, technical onboarding, or program management - for example, delivery roles at enterprise or vertical SaaS companies, technology consulting, or systems integration

  • A demonstrated track record for managing complex client workflows, such as new system implementations or similar projects

  • Strong technical intuition, demonstrated by a STEM background or equivalent experience scoping technical integrations

  • Proven ability to independently manage multiple client engagements end-to-end in a client-facing setting

  • Excellent communication and ability to build strong relationships and influence across internal and external stakeholders

  • Willingness to work in person at our NYC headquarters 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

 

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $180,000 USD. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

  • Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

  • Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

About the team

The Strategy & Positioning team decides how EliseAI competes. We find the strongest case for the company, the platform and every product, and we help set where the platform goes next. We position new products while they are being built, run the competitive motion, and make sure customers understand exactly why EliseAI is worth choosing. The team works directly with the executive team, alongside Product, Engineering and Sales.

About the role

EliseAI already operates in one in five US apartments. For most operators, the question is no longer whether to use AI, but which platform to trust with their operations. Making our case on that question is this team's work.

We're looking for a Senior Associate to own some of the hardest questions in it. Why should a large operator consolidate on our platform instead of buying point solutions? What should a new product be, and how should we introduce it? In the deals we lose, what is the competitor arguing, and how do we beat it? You'll answer questions like these with research, data and argument, bring recommendations to leadership, and carry the answers into launches, sales conversations and the market.

You'll often be handed a question with no playbook and be expected to find the answer, make the case, and see it through. If you want to decide how an AI company competes, not just describe it, this role is for you.

In this role, you will

  • Build the case for EliseAI. Develop the core arguments for the company and its platform, for customers, investors and the market, and keep them true as the product changes

  • Shape where the platform goes. Bring customer, competitive and market insight into product decisions, and help leadership choose what to build next and what not to build yet

  • Position products as they're built. Work with Product to define each new product's audience, claim and proof before launch, so it arrives with a clear reason to buy

  • Run the competitive motion. Know every alternative a customer considers, find where we win, and give Sales the arguments, materials and objection handling to win there

  • Turn positioning into what customers hear. Shape the narratives, decks and launch plans that Sales and Customer Success use, and refine them based on what happens in real deals

  • Measure whether the argument is working. Use win/loss analysis, customer conversations and pipeline data to test which positions change how buyers decide

You might thrive in this role if you

  • Excel at rhetoric, logic and argument. We believe these skills matter more as we approach AGI, not less, and they are the common thread across EliseAI's top performers

  • Can build the strongest version of a position, anticipate the counterarguments, and decide what to leave out

  • Think commercially. You care whether a strategy wins customers, not just whether it's clever

  • Learn complex technical and market material quickly and explain it accurately

  • Hold yourself to high standards of rigor and intellectual honesty, and change your mind when the evidence does

  • Have 2-4 years of experience in consulting, banking, strategy, a high-growth startup, or other work that shows how you think

  • Can work in person in our New York office four days a week

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification. A strong record of thinking and argument matters more to us than a conventional background.

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $130,000 to $180,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We will also consider qualified applicants in accordance with the Austin Fair Chance Hiring Ordinance.

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at interview.accommodations@meetelise.com.

About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

  • Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

  • Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

About the Role

EliseAI is looking for a Field Enablement Specialist to own the in-person adoption experience for our customers as they roll out AI across their properties. You'll work closely with the Director of Operations and the customer education team, acting as both trainer and trusted consultant: diagnosing how a customer's business actually works, then building and delivering the live programs that turn new users into product experts.

This isn't a script-and-deliver role. You'll co-build the AI-powered training tools and customer-specific learning modules you use in the field, and you'll be the feedback loop between what customers need and what our training, customer success, and product teams build next. You’ll be embedded at the forefront of AI, redesigning workflows with the latest advances in agentic AI.

 

What you’ll own

  • Adoption in the field: Design and deliver tailored, interactive live training sessions and workshops that give new and existing customers a deep, working understanding of our products.

  • Consult, don’t just train: Get close to each customer's workflows and onsite operations, and customize every workshop to their specific needs rather than running a one-size-fits-all deck

  • Co-building the toolkit: Partner with the customer education team to develop AI-powered training tools and customer-specific modules that make every future session sharper

  • Closing the feedback loop: Drive our product forward by bringing back actionable feedback from the field

  • Iterating in real time: Proactively seek feedback throughout each training, spotting gaps and adjusting your approach on the spot

  • Work cross-functionally: collaborate with teams across the company to make sure customer training evolves in line with our product, our business, and our customers

  • Stay ahead of the field: track industry trends and best practices in training and onboarding, and bring new approaches back to the team

  • Represent EliseAI: help attract top-tier talent to join the team

  • Travel: up to 75% of the time. This is a field role; the best work happens onsite with the customer

 

Who fits

You come from training, customer experience, consulting, or property operations background, and want to drive adoption and innovation forward across our most critical industries.

  • The natural teacher: you can make a technical product click for a skeptical property manager quickly, and turn them into a champion

  • The consultant instinct: you diagnose how a team actually works before you open the deck, and you customize on the fly when the room needs something different

  • The builder: you want to shape the training tools and modules you use, not just run someone else's script

  • The road warrior: packed travel calendars energize you, not drain you

 

Requirements

  • Ability to conduct sessions in both English and Spanish fluently

  • 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing training, coaching, implementation, or consultant role. Experience in the multifamily industry as a trainer, coach, or onsite team member is a plus

  • Experience translating customer education resources into live, interactive training for diverse audiences

  • Willingness to travel up to 75% of the time to conduct in-person training sessions with clients

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly

  • Technical proficiency, with the ability to quickly learn and demonstrate expertise in our products

  • Proven ability to build rapport with customers and establish trusted advisor relationships.

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

 - Consult, don’t just train: Get close to each customer's workflows and onsite operations, and customize every workshop to their specific needs rather than running a one-size-fits-all deck

 - Co-building the toolkit: Partner with the customer education team to develop AI-powered training tools and customer-specific modules that make every future session sharper

 - Closing the feedback loop: Drive our product forward by bringing back actionable feedback from the field

 - Iterating in real time: Proactively seek feedback throughout each training, spotting gaps and adjusting your approach on the spot

 - Work cross-functionally: collaborate with teams across the company to make sure customer training evolves in line with our product, our business, and our customers

 - Stay ahead of the field: track industry trends and best practices in training and onboarding, and bring new approaches back to the team

 - Represent EliseAI: help attract top-tier talent to join the team

 - Travel: up to 75% of the time. This is a field role; the best work happens onsite with the customer

 

Who fits

You come from training, customer experience, consulting,  or property operations background, and want to drive adoption and innovation forward across our most critical industries.

 - The natural teacher: you can make a technical product click for a skeptical property manager quickly, and turn them into a champion

 - The consultant instinct: you diagnose how a team actually works before you open the deck, and you customize on the fly when the room needs something different

 - The builder: you want to shape the training tools and modules you use, not just run someone else's script

 - The road warrior: packed travel calendars energize you, not drain you

 

Requirements

 - Ability to conduct sessions in both English and Spanish fluently

 - 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing training, coaching, implementation, or consultant role. Experience in the multifamily industry as a trainer, coach, or onsite team member is a plus

 - Experience translating customer education resources into live, interactive training for diverse audiences

 - Willingness to travel up to 75% of the time to conduct in-person training sessions with clients

 - Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly

 - Technical proficiency, with the ability to quickly learn and demonstrate expertise in our products

 - Proven ability to build rapport with customers and establish trusted advisor relationships.

 - Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

  • Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

  • Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

About The Role

EliseAI is hiring a Partner Development Manager to drive revenue generation with our most important Healthcare partners, including EHRs and Practice Management systems. You will report to the VP of Partnerships and work closely with Sales, Strategy and Operations, RevOps, Marketing, and Product.

You take ownership from late-stage activation through co-selling, joint plays, and expansion. Your job is to help a small number of the most critical existing partnerships produce at their ceiling.

Key Responsibilities

  • Relationship Development

    • Build and maintain high-value relationships at the rep, director, and executive level across assigned partner accounts / territories

    • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for partner field teams; along with our Sales team, be the person they call when they have a deal to route

    • Proactively lead joint planning with partner counterparts to develop mutual performance objectives and hit shared revenue targets

    • Represent EliseAI at partner events, conferences, and co-hosted field programs to deepen relationships on the ground

  • Pipeline Generation & Co-Selling

    • Own partner-sourced and partner-linked SQO targets for assigned accounts, as well as playing a key role for maximizing win rates in partner deals

    • Work side-by-side with EliseAI AEs and partner field reps to drive co-selling motions, deal routing, and pipeline conversion

    • Run regular touchpoints including weekly pipeline reviews with partner reps to surface active opportunities, remove blockers, and keep EliseAI top of mind

    • Maintain clean partner attribution in Salesforce from first intro through closed won, and run an efficient deal registration process

  • Enablement

    • Build and deliver rep-level talk tracks, objection handling guides, and qualification criteria for partner field teams

    • Run recurring enablement sessions to keep partner reps sharp on EliseAI positioning, ICP, and deal mechanics

    • Create simple, field-ready materials that make it easy for partner reps to refer and co-sell EliseAI

    • Collaborate with product teams to track and prioritize customer feedback related to partners integrations, and co-develop a joint integration roadmap with our partners

  • Reporting & QBRs

    • Track pipeline health and partner-sourced opportunity progression in Salesforce on a weekly basis

    • Communicate QTD performance, blockers, and opportunities to the GTM leadership team

    • Run business reviews with partner stakeholders covering revenue, pipeline health, and next-play roadmap

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact with significant autonomy.

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

  • 2+ years in a fast-paced, startup GTM motion: sales, partnerships, alliances, or GTM strategy and operations

  • Demonstrated ability to drive revenue through a partner-led or co-selling motion

  • Executive presence with both startup and enterprise stakeholders

  • Strong organization, prioritization, and Salesforce discipline: pipeline hygiene, attribution, and performance reporting

  • Direct, clear communicator, written and verbal; not afraid to speak up or push back

  • Fast executor: does not let perfect be the enemy of good

  • Self-starter with entrepreneurial instincts and high ownership mentality

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

  • Prior Healthcare experience is a plus (but absolutely not a requirement!)

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in near the ground floor of a well-funded startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company in the form of stock options

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Monthly fitness stipend

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and company-paid lunch

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $120,000 to 160,000 OTE. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with EliseAI is on an “at-will” basis, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We will also consider qualified applicants in accordance with the Austin Fair Chance Hiring Ordinance.

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at interview.accommodations@meetelise.com.

EliseAI’s Technical Solutions & Support team are subject matter experts responsible for solving issues and answering questions for our customers. Our Solutions & Support team members possess in-depth system knowledge on our individual client configurations and systems and configuration data access. The team works with other internal teams to troubleshoot customer issues and ensure the best possible customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Deeply understand our systems, customers, and how they work best together:

  • How we onboard clients and translate their preferences into our system’s settings

  • How our integrations work with client email, calendar, CRM, and property management systems

  • How our clients’ businesses work and how issues they report impact their operations

Provide excellent, customer-obsessed support to our clients:

  • Quickly, clearly, and professionally communicate with clients to understand their issues, reproduction steps, and the business impact they’re causing

  • Resolve issues by providing empathetic, over-the-top, extra-mile customer service

  • Prioritize your time according to the issue's impact on our clients’ businesses

  • Advise clients on best practices for configuring and interacting with their AI Assistant

Investigate and document bugs:

  • Investigate issues' root cause and impact using SQL queries, logs, and other data sources

  • Write highly effective ticket summaries that provide clear descriptions of the issue, how to reproduce it, its business impact, and relevant documents that will help prioritize the issue and quickly solve it

  • Communicate bug fixes to our clients, confirm the issue is solved, and share these updates with your team members

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent field 

  • 1-3 years of experience in similar role or field

  • Experience with support software and CRMs (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce) is a plus 

  • Demonstrated technical proficiency such as a computer science degree, bootcamp certificate, or previous work experience

  • Bias towards data-driven decision-making and analytical skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills 

  • Experience in a customer-facing role is a plus 

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 5 days a week

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff. We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Nice to haves include

  • Computer Science degree, bootcamp certificate, or equivalent

  • Experience building projects using low code / no code tools such as Retool

  • Advanced knowledge of Google Sheets or Excel

  • Familiarity with DataDog or other similar event-logging software

  • Familiarity with Postman or other API testing tools

  • Familiarity with Reporting tools such as Tableau

  • Experience writing SQL queries

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $100,000 - $135,000 CAD. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors, including experience, skill level, location, and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

  • Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

About the role

We're seeking a People Operations Associate with a strong focus on onboarding and new hire experience. At the core of this role is the ability to run a high-volume, end-to-end onboarding process, ensuring every new hire feels prepared, welcomed, and set up for success from day one. This role also supports the broader day-to-day operations of our People function in a high-growth environment, with a strong emphasis on leveraging automation, AI tools, and workflow platforms to build efficient, scalable people operations. It's a great fit for someone who is operationally minded, energized by process improvement, and excited to help shape what modern people ops looks like.

 

Key Responsibilities

Onboarding and new hire experience

  • Coordinate end-to-end onboarding for new hires, including pre-employment background checks, new hire paperwork, I-9 verification, travel arrangements, and any other pre-boarding coordination

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for new hires throughout their onboarding journey, managing start date tracking and ensuring a smooth transition into the company

  • Prepare and distribute onboarding materials including employee handbooks and policy documents

  • Own the updating and management of new hire training materials and live sessions, both in the LMS and in person, in coordination with cross-functional teams

  • Collaborate with IT to ensure new hires have system access set up, and conduct laptop setup sessions with new employees

  • Continuously look for ways to automate and improve the onboarding experience and streamline processes for scale

Operations, automation, and scaling people processes

  • Own the operational infrastructure that keeps our people processes running smoothly and efficiently. Identify manual, repetitive workflows across the people function and lead efforts to automate them through AI tools, workflow platforms, and smarter use of our existing systems

  • Build and maintain the trackers, dashboards, and reporting tools that keep the team organized and data-informed

  • Document processes clearly as you build them, creating a foundation that scales with the company

HR systems and administration

  • Manage transactions in our HRIS, including adding new hire profiles, processing status changes, and handling off boarding

  • Maintain accurate employee and company records, including personnel files and org charts

  • Draft employment verification letters, offer letters, and other employment-related correspondence

  • Ensure accuracy and compliance with company policies and legal requirements, including wage rate notices, labor law postings, and required training such as harassment prevention

  • Support immigration processes and documentation for candidates and existing employees

  • Assist with auditing HR data and identifying opportunities to improve data integrity and process efficiency

  • Support compensation and benefits administration, including helping employees navigate enrollment, changes, and general questions

Employee relations and manager support

  • Serve as a reliable first point of contact for employee questions related to HR policies, benefits, and general people operations

  • Support managers with people-related processes including performance review cycles, promotion documentation, and role changes

  • Help coordinate and track performance management cycles, ensuring timelines are communicated and followed across the organization

  • Assist with sensitive employee situations with professionalism and a high degree of discretion

Employee experience and culture

  • Manage company swag inventory and coordinate distribution for new hires, birthdays, work anniversaries, and other employee engagement moments

  • Coordinate employee recognition efforts including anniversary and birthday gift-giving programs

Cross-functional and project support

  • Support HR-related projects spanning administration, compliance, employee experience, and organizational culture

  • Partner with Finance, Legal, and other teams on cross-functional people initiatives such as headcount planning, policy updates, and compliance reporting

  • Assist with building and documenting scalable HR processes as the company grows

  • Take on stretch projects and ad-hoc assignments across the people function as business needs evolve

     

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

 

Requirements

  • 1 to 2 years of experience in HR Operations, Compensation and Benefits, or a related field

  • Proven experience with people operations fundamentals, including I-9 verification, onboarding workflows, HRIS data entry, and HR compliance basics

  • A genuine interest in the people function and a desire to grow within HR and people operations

  • Strong interpersonal skills coupled with excellent written and verbal communication

  • Exceptional organization and detail orientation, with a strong focus on data accuracy and integrity and an unmatched ability to manage multiple priorities

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and staying composed when priorities shift

  • Data-savvy with proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets; comfortable building and maintaining trackers, running reports, and working with people data to surface insights

  • A natural bias toward automation and process improvement; you look for opportunities to reduce manual work and build more scalable, efficient systems

  • Able to apply discretion to sensitive situations and maintain a high level of confidentiality

  • Self-starter with natural curiosity and a motivation to problem-solve and troubleshoot

  • Comfortable interacting with and supporting employees at all levels of the organization

  • Tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools and systems

  • Willing to work in person from our Midtown Manhattan office 5 days a week

     

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded startup that’s scaling. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

 

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

 

Job Compensation Range:

The salary range for this role is $85,000 - $115,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation inclusive of salary and any bonuses is determined based on a number of factors including experience and skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with EliseAI is on an “at-will” basis, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We will also consider qualified applicants in accordance with the Austin Fair Chance Hiring Ordinance.

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at interview.accommodations@meetelise.com.

You will be the in-house authority on multifamily accounting, helping teams deliver products that interact seamlessly with our client accounting teams and systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advise on core scenarios - Guide treatment of rent, concessions, deposits/refunds, subsidies/HAP, delinquencies, utilities, move-in/out, and month-end close

  • Translate workflows into requirements - Turn real-world accounting cases into clear requirements and acceptance tests; pressure-test features before release

  • Review calculations and language - Validate prorations, allocations, adjustments, and charge/credit logic for accuracy and explainability

  • Lead testing and validation - Develop representative test cases, run UAT with client accountants, and confirm outputs reconcile to expectations

  • Define standards and terminology - Establish consistent event lifecycles, terms, and concise reference guides for controllers and onsite teams

  • Capture best practices - Distill patterns and edge cases from enterprise customers into durable standards and playbooks

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in multifamily property accounting or controllership at a PMC/owner-operator/REIT (ideally multifamily)

  • Deep knowledge across GL & sub-ledgers, resident ledgers, deposits, and close; strong US GAAP grounding

  • Comfortable communicating with client accounting/operations/leasing teams

  • Crisp stakeholder communications, including writing & presentations

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Preferred

  • Experience working in a software / SaaS environment

  • Familiarity with leading multifamily systems and data handoffs

  • Familiarity with AI and/or automation as they relate to accounting workflows

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $110,000 - $150,000 USD/CAD. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process.
